content:
Apple today released iOS 27 along with companion updates, including two major improvements to the HomePod 27 software.

HomePod 27 brings AutoMix to Apple Music, improves AirPlay performance, and fixes a number of bugs

HomePod 27 is the latest software update for HomePod. You can install it through the Home app on your iPhone, under Home Settings ⇾ Software Update.

Here are Apple's official release notes for HomePod 27:

In addition to bug fixes and security updates, HomePod 27 includes two notable changes:

  • AutoMix for Apple Music
  • Faster AirPlay connection speeds

AutoMix first debuted on iOS last year, and this year the feature has been further enhanced and expanded to HomePod and Apple TV.

With AutoMix, the transitions between songs feel more like having a DJ at a party or venue. This feature is perfect for HomePod because it can fill the entire home with music.

The AirPlay improvement may sound like a small change, but in actual use it makes a noticeable difference, letting you connect to your HomePod faster than before. During my time using the iOS 27 beta, switching playback between iPhone and HomePod was both fast and effortless, which really impressed me.

HomePod 27 does not offer Siri AI features. However, these are expected to arrive alongside a new HomePod hardware update in the coming months.
